hypotheses.F0_factorial_recomposes: The four-factor Shapley decomposition exactly recomposes both the local edge-write change and every finite downstream contrast to relative error at most 1e-5.
hypotheses.F1_boundary_edge_hybrid_transfers_style: Changing only the L9H8 boundary edge from original to counterfactual QK/value factors moves the disjoint spelling contrast correctly in at least 60% of examples in every fold/split cell.
hypotheses.F2_contextual_value_dominates_routing: The current-value factor has greater signed mean than the two QK factors combined in at least five of six L9H8 boundary cells and positive local target-projection share in every cell.
hypotheses.F3_persistent_bus_is_negative_control: The persistent Layer-0 value-bus factor has absolute local and downstream contribution below 1e-6 in every L9H8 boundary cell because the boundary token is unchanged.
hypotheses.F4_factorized_transport_is_boundary_spec: The median signed total shift for L9H8 boundary edges is at least 1.5 times the matched non-boundary shift.
hypotheses.F5_factorized_transport_is_head_specific: L9H8 boundary total win rate exceeds L9H7 at the same boundary by at least 0.05 in at least five of six cells.
hypotheses.F6_declared_contrast_beats_random: The L9H8 boundary total shift exceeds the 95th percentile of balanced random target-token contrasts in at least five of six cells.
